notes: Scouted TH16 layout candidates for digitizing. 'clean' = top-down layout-editor image with building pads and no watermark; only the Blueprint ranked base meets that bar. Clash Champs images are full-village screenshots with a centre watermark and ~16 px per tile half-width; AllClash images are cropped at the left/right corners. Every candidate has an in-game layout link: the most reliable way to get a usable image is to open the link in game and take a layout-editor screenshot plus a trap-view screenshot (user action). Excluded: TH17/18 bases, farm/progress bases, AllClash Dec 2025 bases and the Jan 2026 AllClash entries whose links are TH17. Clash Champs 'Pro' is the site's style tag, not a builder credential; builders there are community uploaders.
